events.description: Police in riot gear engage with a crowd of protesters holding Union Jack flags; physical pushing and shoving occurs near a police vehicle, indicating violent group clash.

A violent group confrontation is ongoing: police in riot gear are positioned behind armored vehicles while smoke (likely from tear gas or incendiary devices) erupts above and behind them, and debris is visible on the ground; officers adjust shields and stances amid apparent projectile impacts and rising smoke, indicating active unrest.
A person in a red jacket lunges forward and appears to strike or grapple with another individual in a blue tracksuit; the motion is aggressive and physical, consistent with mutual combat.

A large group of people engages in chaotic movement amid a sudden release of white smoke or gas (likely CS gas or similar), causing dispersal and panic; police in riot gear are visible in later frames, indicating a violent public disorder event.

A sudden, intense burst of white smoke/gas erupts from ground level near the crowd, expanding rapidly—consistent with a canister discharge or small explosive device detonation (e.g., tear gas grenade).
A vehicle is engulfed in flames on a street at dusk, with thick black smoke rising; multiple police vehicles and officers are present, indicating a response to civil unrest or violent incident.

A car is stationary and fully engulfed in fire at the start of the sequence; while the fire is ongoing, the initial ignition likely followed a collision or deliberate act—however, no direct visual evidence of impact (e.g., deformation, skid marks, pre-impact motion) is visible in these frames, so confidence is moderate and event is inferred from context of fire origin.

A vehicle is engulfed in flames on a street at night while emergency personnel (police van and officers) are present; a Union Jack flag is held prominently in the foreground, indicating a politically charged protest or unrest context. The sustained fire, presence of law enforcement, and symbolic flag suggest collective violent unrest rather than an isolated accident.

A car is fully engulfed in large flames with thick smoke, suggesting it may have been involved in a collision or deliberate ignition shortly before this segment; however, no direct impact or crash is visible in the provided frames—only the aftermath of a burning vehicle.

A nighttime street scene showing a large Union Jack flag held by individuals in the foreground, with a vehicle engulfed in flames and an emergency vehicle (likely ambulance or police van) visible in the background; consistent with collective violent unrest.
